why_it_moved.text: Users ran more queries (+2.60%) and reformulated more (+5.50%), yet Successful Search Rate is down (-0.45%). That fits repeat searching after weak first results.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate is the registered hypothesis metric, and its drop is concentrated in Informational queries (down 0.85%) while Desktop rose 1.52%. No cut has been run to explain this yet.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Success per query flat or down while Queries per User rises would confirm activity without success.
A similar query repeated within 5 minutes rising in Test would confirm worse results; flat would point to real extra demand.

analyst_view.reason: The pre-registered primary is Queries per User, but the hypothesis is Successful Search Rate, which is down 0.45% and clearly below zero. Reformulation Rate is up 5.50%. More searching with less success can mean worse results, so settle the success cuts first.
